extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection in Jinja2 — Arbitrary code execution on the server, leading to full compromise of the system, data exfiltration, or further lateral movement. [verified: The username parameter is directly concatenated into a Jinja2 template string on line 14 without any sanitization or validation, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary template expressions (e.g., {{config}}) that lead to server-side template execution.]
